messages:
incident-bot: CRITICAL: Dedicated pool 'dp-asterion-west3' hitting sustained GPU saturation (tenant: asterion-enterprise). Paging oncall-sre. metrics: gpu_util=98%, queue_len=420, p95_latency=2.4s.
frank_oncall: I’m on it. pulling up pool health and evictions.
alice_sre: seeing lots of small inference jobs from tenant asterion, KV cache pressure high. p50 token latency climbing.
ben_infra: infra view: AZ west3 has 8/10 GPUs at 100% user, 2 at 95%. autoscaler didn't fire—policy cap at 10 nodes. 
george_eng: logs show steady ~1.5k rps from tenant over last 12m. pattern looks like a sudden traffic spike (model shard reloads?).
frank_oncall: can we isolate tenant? options: 1) manual burst (spin reserved burst nodes in west3) 2) throttle non-critical or multi-tenant best-effort jobs 3) re-route some traffic to west2 replica. Which is fastest?
ben_infra: fastest is manual add of 4 reserved GPUs (takes ~6m to provision). re-route needs config push and model warmup (~15-20m). throttling needs orchestration but we can evict best-effort within 3m.
clara_pm: what's customer impact? Dan, support—are Asterion customers reporting errors?
dan_support: Support inbox: asterion-rep flagged timeouts from their users, about 10% errors in the last 8m. They’re noticing slower streaming results.
eva_sales: flagged on account side. Asterion is in active rollout — they’ll escalate externally if we don’t mitigate quickly.
frank_oncall: proposed immediate steps: A) evict best-effort/low-priority tenants from dp-asterion-west3 (non-enterprise) B) kick off manual burst + start 4 GPUs C) contact Asterion PM with ETA. Agree?
george_eng: eviction safe, but need to ensure no data-plane config drift. I'll run the eviction script. snippet: ```/opt/redwood/bin/evict_jobs --pool dp-asterion-west3 --priority<=best-effort --dry-run=false```
alice_sre: I'll watch KV cache rebuilds after new nodes join. set alert for cache-miss spike.
ben_infra: provisioning burst nodes now (request id b-3723). ETA ~6m. provisioning logs: ```request b-3723 accepted -> allocating instances -> ok```
frank_oncall: doing eviction now. posting immediate metrics pre/post.
frank_oncall: pre-evict snapshot: gpu_util=98%, queue_len=420, active_jobs=1287
frank_oncall: eviction went through — removed 142 best-effort jobs. queue_len dropped to 180 in ~30s. gpu_util=95%
alice_sre: good. burst nodes are initializing. watch p95.
ben_infra: burst nodes healthy and joined pool. new capacity +4 GPUs. post-join: gpu_util=72%, queue_len=60, p95_latency=610ms
dan_support: I’ve DM'd Asterion support lead with incident notice and ETA 12m for full stabilization. they acknowledged.
eva_sales: thanks — they want a short incident note to their CSM. Clara, can you coordinate?
clara_pm: on it. drafting note. include mitigation steps and follow-up postmortem.
george_eng: root-cause triage: looks like tenant-side traffic spike combined with a recent model rollout that increased cache misses. will open a TKT and ping model-onboard.
frank_oncall: for now system stable. action items: - george_eng open TKT for model rollout correlation - alice_sre monitor cache and perf for 2h - ben_infra evaluate autoscaler cap and propose threshold change - clara_pm coordinate customer comms - dan_support track any residual errors
frank_oncall: handing off to alice for overnight watch. next-oncall @frank_oncall -> @alice_sre at 3723456905. summary: manual eviction + burst added 4 GPUs, queue back within SLOs, customer contacted.
alice_sre: ack taking over. I’ll keep a 30m cadence report in thread and escalate if p95 > 1s.
incident-bot: NOTE: incident logged -> INC-3723, severity: P1 -> assigned to oncall-sre + eng-runtime.
frank_oncall: thx team. leaving notes in postmortem template. :white_check_mark:
